reasoning: The caller supplies one image as a first-frame anchor and asks only for it to be animated with slow drifting motion. The image is a portrait-format composite character sheet, and it is wired as an actual frame at 0ms, so the entire sheet — all three rows of panels plus its existing lettering (HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, BOOTS) — must remain the whole frame at that instant and must not be cropped into a hero detail. A single continuous take is chosen: a slow push-in drift that adds gentle living motion (rain streaks, wet-ground reflections, faint fabric and hair shift in the hero panel) while the panel layout, labels and figure appearance are preserved. No speech, music or new on-screen text is requested, so all scope flags stay false, and no replacement is requested.

shots.action: The complete portrait-format character reference sheet fills the frame exactly as supplied: the wide rainy-night hero panel across the top, with its metal railings on both sides, rain-slicked reflective walkway, dark building facade and warm amber lights in the distance; the row of three full-body studio turnaround views beneath it labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE and BACK against a near-black backdrop; and the four close-up detail crops of FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS and BOOTS along the bottom, with the HERO title and every panel label left in place. No panel, label or figure is cropped away as the sheet is brought to life: rain streaks slide slowly down the top panel, faint ripples and reflections drift across the wet pavement, and the black-clad figure with short dark hair, shaved sides and small tied knot at the back breathes with the gentlest shift of jacket collar and shoulders, the scar through one eyebrow unchanged; the studio views and detail crops hold steady with only the softest play of light across the dark backdrop as the camera drifts slowly forward over the whole sheet.
subjects: the complete portrait-format character reference sheet with the rainy-night hero panel, three studio turnaround views and four detail crops labeled HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS and BOOTS
shots.what_changes: The framing tightens gradually in a slow forward drift while rain, wet-ground reflections and the faint breathing shift of the figure introduce gentle motion; the panel layout, lettering and figure appearance stay intact throughout.
